Container.Name: nft-floor-prices
Container.Overview:
Cardano NFT Floor Price Service - A standalone microservice that continuously collects Cardano NFT floor prices from TapTools API and serves them via REST API.
Designed to run 24/7 to work around TapTools rate limits (100 calls/day). Spreads API calls over 24 hours and stores prices in SQLite for instant retrieval.
Use with ABCT (A Better Crypto Tracker) or any application needing Cardano NFT floor prices.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Port for the REST API. Access status at http://[IP]:8080/status

Config.Name: Data Directory
Config.Description: Persistent storage for SQLite database with floor prices and history

Config.Name: TapTools API Key
Config.Description: Your TapTools API key (required). Get one at https://taptools.io

Config.Name: Update Interval (minutes)
Config.Description: Minutes between price update cycles. Default 15 = 4 updates/hour = 96 API calls/day (under 100 limit)

Config.Name: API Calls Per Update
Config.Description: Number of collection price fetches per update cycle. Keep at 1 to stay under rate limits.
